== Notes ==
* Useful for gaining energy when combined with [[Condition#Skills which inflict conditions on oneself|skills that inflict conditions on oneself]], e.g. [[Cultist's Fervor]] or [[Foul Feast]].
* [[Hero]]es will use this even when they do not have a condition.

== Trivia ==
* [[Angorodon]]s are dinosaur Necromancers in Eye of the North that use Angorodon's Gaze.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
